about: The cases both sides of a history filter are tested against (DESIGN.md sections 29.5 and 30): backend/tests/test_runfilter.py runs them through the server's SQL, frontend/src/history.test.ts through the page's matches(). Runs are listed newest first, as the history shows them; mode is the runs table's mode; deleted means the run is in the bin. A filter's deleted is false (the history, the default), true (only the bin) or null (either).

cases.name: no filter shows the history, without the bin
kept shows the kept runs of the history, whatever their state or kind
not kept shows the rest of the history
deleted shows the bin, kept or not
kept and deleted shows what is kept in the bin
